parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is the switch or handle of the faucet, typically made of stainless steel for durability and corrosion resistance.
parts.Functional_description: It controls the water flow and temperature by rotating or lifting to open or close the valve inside the faucet.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate or tilt depending on the faucet design, allowing the user to adjust water flow and temperature.

parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body or frame of the faucet, made of brass for strength and corrosion resistance.
parts.Functional_description: It houses the internal water channels and connects the switch and spout, ensuring proper water flow through the faucet.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the structural support for the faucet assembly.

parts.name: Spout
parts.Basic_description: This is the spout of the faucet, made of stainless steel to resist corrosion and provide a smooth water outlet.
parts.Functional_description: It directs the water flow from the faucet body to the sink or basin.
parts.Movement_description: It may swivel or remain fixed depending on the faucet design, allowing directional control of water flow.
